fast_domain.fibre_point:
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
/-- PCUH: fresh (checked `index >>> 9#i32`) = gate (`wrapping_shr index 9#u32`): the shift amount is in range (PRVH.usize_shr9). -/
theorem PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.fibre_point : @NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.fibre_point = @NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point := by
  delta NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.fibre_point NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point
  simp only [PRVH.usize_shr9, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.TABLE_A, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.TABLE_B, PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.table_value, lift]
#print axioms PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.fibre_point
fast_domain.line_node:
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000 in
/-- PCUH: CONDITIONAL_ON_BINDING (the fresh namespace binds the external M31.ONE to the gate value, see NFN_prelude). -/
theorem PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.line_node : @NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.line_node = @NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.line_node := by
  delta NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.line_node NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.line_node NEW_GeometryActual.PRVFresh_NFN_ExtractedGeometry.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
  simp only [PRVEq.NFN_ExtractedGeometry.fast_domain.fibre_point, bind_tc_ok]
